assessment.reasoning: Transaction 3631383 ($1,336.84) was flagged by real-time model risk score (0.66). Investigation of graph and historical evidence reveals no corroborating indicators of fraud. First, the transaction occurred in-person in region 205, where the card has established history (7 prior transactions, 2.2% of card volume). Two days earlier on 2017-01-06, another high-value in-person transaction (3631424, $1,023.18) for the same product category W took place in region 205, demonstrating ongoing regional presence and consistent spending magnitude rather than sudden out-of-region card cloning. Second, the cardholder has not disputed the transaction; in bank history, model-only alerts without customer dispute frequently resolve to legitimate travel, as seen in CC-5401 on this same card where a $1,502.41 transaction scored at 0.95 was confirmed as legitimate travel. Third, the transaction was conducted in-person without device or proxy involvement, and the card is not in a fraud ring (ring_id -1). Community 119537790 has a lift of 5.0, but community lift is weak circumstantial evidence and shared origin analysis for region 205 shows zero lift. Therefore, the activity is consistent with legitimate cardholder spending.
